d: Mercedes once ruled Formula 1, winning eight consecutive Constructors' Championships. Then came the struggles of the ground-effect era, Lewis Hamilton's exit and four seasons of searching for answers. Now, the Silver Arrows are back with a Constructors' title and a new champion in Kimi Antonelli. George Russell has been great as well. Rupha Ramani looks back at the decisions, setbacks and people behind Mercedes' return to the top of F1.
